_readme: PSA 10 prices, and the raw near-mint figures that come with them. One store
for graded prices across the whole site: the set guides read it for their
chase cards, and the hunt list reads it for the cards being chased.
TWO SECTIONS, AND THE PERSON ALWAYS WINS.
prices  what a human entered, through the Chase Cards tab of the
spreadsheet. Read first. A sync never touches this.
auto    what scripts/sync-prices.mjs fetched. It owns and overwrites this
section on every run. Read only when `prices` has no entry.
So a number Tim checked himself can never be silently replaced by a feed.
KEY FORMAT is <set-id>-<card-number>, matching the ids in sets.json:
"pitch-black-116"  is Mega Darkrai ex, Special Illustration Rare.
Card numbers are what disambiguate; the same Pokemon often appears three
times in one set at three rarities.
A card with no entry in either section shows its raw TCGplayer price alone,
which is the honest default. Nothing is ever guessed.
